Generated seccomp BPF filter for QUIC syscalls, allowing write, fsync, and getrandom.

# Purpose
This header defines a generated seccomp filter for the QUIC code path. It builds a `sock_filter` program that checks the runtime architecture, then allows only `write`, `fsync`, and `getrandom` system calls, with `write` and `fsync` limited to the file descriptors passed as `logfile_fd` and `keylog_fd`. Any other system call, or any call with a mismatched architecture, ends with `SECCOMP_RET_KILL_PROCESS`. The file also exposes `sock_filter_policy_quic_instr_cnt` and the helper [`populate_sock_filter_policy_quic`](<#populate_sock_filter_policy_quic>) to copy the filter into caller memory.
